leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive React component to render nested tree data
Apply conditional rendering to display expand/collapse UI based on node state
Construct a click handler to toggle node expansion state
Configure component props to pass node data and event handlers through recursion
Initialize component state to track expanded/collapsed status for tree nodes
Render nested tree structures with proper indentation and visual hierarchy
Manipulate component state to control which branches are expanded or collapsed
